title: Hyperlapse
description: A hyperlapse combines time-lapse with significant camera movement through space. Time is compressed while the camera advances in steps that assemble into a glide, so crowds and weather race along a real path.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Duration becomes velocity. A walk that would take an afternoon becomes a few seconds, but unlike a locked time-lapse the station point travels: streets are traversed, not merely watched from one roof.
It is the wrong tool for real-time tracking, and the wrong tool for a tripod time-lapse of clouds over a still city. If the camera did not move between frames, it is not a hyperlapse.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Shoot discrete frames along a surveyed path (or simulate that in 3D), then play them at time-lapse rates. Align each frame so the move reads as a glide.
Crowds, traffic, and shadows should race. Prompt a hyperlapse toward or around the subject, time compressed, crowds and weather racing, camera advancing in steps that become a glide.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to show duration as velocity along a path. Concrete beat: approaching a monument while hours of foot traffic smear.
Do not hyperlapse a 6-second real-time conversation.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Time-Lapse is often a locked or slowly panned interval. Tracking Shot is real-time travel.
Hyperlapse is both: interval shooting plus significant displacement. A Slider Shot interval on 100 centimeters is a tiny cousin, not a city traverse.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Koyaanisqatsi compresses traffic and weather into velocity, sometimes from moving viewpoints. Baraka and related city-interval work sit in the same family.
Music-video hyperlapse made the stepped camera path a popular grammar. Use time plus travel, not a particular skyline.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a locked Time-Lapse or a real-time Tracking Shot shot with a speed ramp. The tell is a still station point, or real-time gait.
The fix: camera position changes between frames, time compressed, path readable as a glide.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Hyperlapse in film?
It is time-lapse shot while the camera moves a significant distance, so both time and viewpoint are compressed into one glide.
Hyperlapse vs Time-Lapse
A classic time-lapse often sits on a locked tripod. Hyperlapse relocates the camera between frames, traversing space as hours pass.
When should I use Hyperlapse?
When a long approach or a city's duration should play as speed. Do not use it for real-time dialogue.
How do I prompt Hyperlapse for AI image or video?
Write hyperlapse, camera advancing through space, time compressed, crowds and clouds racing. Ban a locked tripod time-lapse and ban real-time tracking.
